name: Fly Trap
source:
Two girls in a wilderness therapy camp reckon with a ghostly presence. It brings them all closer.

[From [url=https://easelflake.itch.io/fly-trap]itch.io[/url]]

兩個女孩在一個荒野治療營裡不得不面對一個幽靈般的存在。這件事讓她們所有人都親近了些。
